title: WordPress template writes preserve title and area and Retry only repairs receipt-proven slug resets
steps: Run the three declared Node test suites.
expect: Real template content updates send complete content/title/area and no-op updates make zero writes.
Filled Retry validates full projected structure and copyHash before repairing title defaults with exact raw and body revision receipts.
Unrelated structure or revision drift and uncertain writes block all corrections; Retry after one verified correction only writes the remaining correction.
fence: No title casefold or normalization; original copy receipts stay unchanged and repair receipts record their source hash.
